# Environmental spell source snapshots

These three YAML files are byte-for-byte copies from Foundry D&D5e commit
`965ad2d0cf5d063dac675ba078b5bd3c3c0dd449`, under
`packs/_source/spells24/{1st,2nd,3rd}-level/`. They retain the upstream
`system.source.license: CC-BY-4.0` and source identities. Rules text is SRD
5.2.1 content, Wizards of the Coast LLC, licensed under
[CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

The hermetic regeneration tests use these snapshots so a clean checkout does
not require the ignored maintainer-only `raw_sources/foundry` tree.
